milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the crafted wooden_axe ends up in the player's inventory. Player starts with exactly 3 oak_planks + 2 sticks (the exact recipe) and must use the crafting table at (~3,0,2). Not satisfiable at init since no wooden_axe exists in starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because mining a wool block drops the wool item into inventory. Player starts with no wool items. Light blue wool blocks are placed at (~-4,0,3), (~-4,1,3), and (~-3,0,3). Breaking any one of them adds light_blue_wool to inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task where the player must navigate to the magenta wool blocks and observe them. Target is the center of the magenta wool cluster at (~5,1,3). Player spawns at (0,0,0) which is ~5.9 blocks away (exceeds max_distance=5), so not satisfied at init. Facing tolerance of 60° ensures player is looking toward the blocks.

Uses inventory_has because shearing a white sheep drops white_wool into inventory. This is unambiguous since no white wool blocks exist in the scene (only light_blue and magenta wool blocks are placed). The only source of white_wool is shearing one of the two white NoAI sheep at (~0,0,5) and (~1,0,6). Player has shears in starting inventory.
